items.heading: The wire behind every switch and point
items.description:
Good wiring is invisible once the walls are closed — which is exactly why it has to be right the first time. We size every circuit to its connected load, run FR (flame-retardant), FR-LSH (low smoke and halogen) or LSOH cable depending on the occupancy, and colour-code phase, neutral and earth to IS 694 so any electrician can trace a fault years later.

Runs are looped through junction boxes, not spliced mid-wall, and every DB is labelled circuit-by-circuit before handover — so your snag list is a formality, not a scramble.
items.checklist:
FR, FR-LSH & LSOH insulation for homes, offices and public buildings
IS 694 colour-coded phase, neutral and earth conductors
Sized to connected load — not a flat gauge across the whole flat
Looped, labelled circuits with as-built wiring diagrams on handover
Genuine RR Kabel product, correctly earthed and megger-tested

ConstructionInnerBanner.headline: Switchgear sized to your load, not a shelf part number
ConstructionInnerBanner.subtitle: MCB, MCCB and ACB protection, SPN/TPN distribution boards and custom-built panel boards — sized to your connected load and fault level, to IS/IEC standards.

items.heading: The protection layer that keeps everything else safe
items.description:
Every circuit downstream of a switchgear panel is only as safe as its protection device — an MCB rated too high won't trip when it should, one rated too low nuisance-trips under normal load. We calculate connected load, diversity and short-circuit current before selecting MCB, MCCB or ACB ratings, and build SPN/TPN distribution boards and custom panel boards to match.

Every panel is single-line diagrammed, labelled circuit-by-circuit, and tested before handover — so a fault years later is a five-minute fix, not a guessing game.
items.checklist:
MCB, MCCB and ACB protection sized to connected load and fault current
SPN/TPN distribution boards and custom-built panel boards
Single-line diagram and circuit labelling on every panel, on handover
IS/IEC compliant selectivity between upstream and downstream devices
Genuine Schneider Electric product with manufacturer warranty

ConstructionInnerBanner.headline: Servo stabilizers that protect what voltage swings destroy
ConstructionInnerBanner.subtitle: Servo-controlled voltage stabilizers, single and three-phase — protecting CNC machines, medical equipment and cold-storage from the voltage swings that damage them.

items.heading: Regulation tight enough to protect sensitive loads
items.description:
CNC machines, medical imaging equipment and cold-storage compressors don't fail because of a power cut — they fail from the voltage swing right before or after one. Servo-controlled stabilizers correct voltage with roughly ±1% regulation accuracy, far tighter than a static or relay-type stabilizer, and we size them to the connected equipment's inrush current, not just its running load.

Every unit is installed with proper bypass arrangement so maintenance never means downtime, and we commission with a load test before handover.
items.checklist:
Single-phase and three-phase servo-controlled units
≈±1% output regulation accuracy — tighter than static/relay types
Sized to equipment inrush current, not just steady-state load
Bypass arrangement fitted so maintenance doesn't mean downtime
Load-tested at commissioning before handover

items.heading: The switch that safely isolates HT power
items.description:
Before anyone can safely work on downstream HT equipment, there has to be a load break switch that can isolate it under load, cleanly and visibly. We supply and install 12/24/36 kV, 630 A, 25 kA rated outdoor LBS panels and ring-main units, positioned and interlocked so isolation sequences can't be done in the wrong order.

Every panel is commissioned with insulation and mechanical interlock testing, and documented for the utility or plant's electrical safety records.
items.checklist:
12 / 24 / 36 kV rated, 630 A, 25 kA outdoor panels
Ring-main unit configurations for looped HT distribution
Mechanical interlocks that prevent an unsafe isolation sequence
Insulation and interlock tested at commissioning
Documented for utility, plant and audit electrical safety records

ConstructionInnerBanner.headline: Commercial refrigeration for retail and F&B
ConstructionInnerBanner.subtitle: Visi coolers, deep freezers, water coolers and ice-cube machines — sized and installed for retail, F&B and cold-chain applications.

items.heading: Cold-chain equipment that holds its temperature
items.description:
Retail and food-service refrigeration lives or dies on consistent temperature — a visi cooler cycling too warm spoils stock quietly, before anyone notices. We size deep freezers, visi coolers, water coolers and ice-cube machines to actual storage volume and ambient conditions, and install condensing units with proper airflow clearance so they run at rated efficiency.

For pharma and hospital cold-chain, we additionally fit temperature logging so compliance records are automatic, not a manual clipboard entry.
items.checklist:
Visi coolers, deep freezers, water coolers and ice-cube machines
Sized to actual storage volume and site ambient conditions
Condensing units installed with correct airflow clearance
Optional temperature logging for pharma and hospital cold-chain
Genuine Blue Star product with manufacturer warranty

ConstructionInnerBanner.headline: Fire alarm systems, engineered to compliance
ConstructionInnerBanner.imageAlt: Fire alarm strobe and horn device mounted on a wall
ConstructionInnerBanner.subtitle: Conventional and addressable fire alarm panels, smoke and heat detectors, manual call points and hooters — designed to NBC and TAC norms.

items.heading: Detection that's zoned right, and actually tested
items.description:
A fire alarm system is only as reliable as its zoning and its detector selection — a heat detector where a smoke detector was needed delays warning by critical minutes. We design zone-wise detector placement (smoke, heat or multi-sensor as the space needs), select conventional or addressable panels based on building size and reporting needs, and route manual call points and hooters per NBC/TAC guidelines.

Every zone is function-tested at commissioning, and we hand over a zone chart so any future fault is located immediately.
items.checklist:
Conventional and addressable panels selected to building size
Zone-wise smoke, heat and multi-sensor detector placement
Manual call points and hooters routed to NBC/TAC guidelines
Every zone function-tested at commissioning
Zone chart handed over for immediate future fault-finding

ConstructionInnerBanner.headline: Fire fighting systems, sized to occupancy
ConstructionInnerBanner.imageAlt: Fire fighting extinguisher and hose reel
ConstructionInnerBanner.subtitle: Sprinkler networks, hydrant systems, fire pump houses and portable extinguishers — sized to occupancy classification, per NBC 2016 and TAC norms.

items.heading: Suppression sized to occupancy, not a flat spec
items.description:
Fire suppression requirements differ sharply by occupancy — a warehouse, a hospital ward and a hotel banquet hall each need a different sprinkler density and hydrant coverage. We design sprinkler networks and hydrant systems to the building's occupancy classification, size jockey, main and standby pumps to the resulting demand, and place portable extinguishers and hose reels per code, not just at the fire-safety officer's guess.

Every system is hydro-tested and flow-tested at commissioning, with documentation ready for fire-NOC and insurance audits.
items.checklist:
Sprinkler networks and hydrant systems sized to occupancy class
Jockey, main and standby pump houses sized to hydraulic demand
Portable extinguishers and hose reels placed to code, not guesswork
Hydro-tested and flow-tested at commissioning
Documentation ready for fire-NOC and insurance audit

ConstructionInnerBanner.headline: PA systems that reach every zone clearly
ConstructionInnerBanner.imageAlt: Public address speaker system mounted on a ceiling
ConstructionInnerBanner.subtitle: Zone-wise public address for announcements and background music, with emergency voice-evacuation (EVAC) for life-safety compliance.

items.heading: Audio that's intelligible, zone by zone
items.description:
A PA system that's just loud isn't the same as one that's intelligible — reverberant halls and long corridors both need speaker spacing and amplifier tap settings calculated for the space, not a single speaker type everywhere. We zone the system for independent announcements per area, add background music routing where needed, and integrate emergency voice-evacuation (EVAC) with the fire alarm panel where life-safety code requires it.

Every zone is speech-intelligibility checked at commissioning, and the EVAC integration is tested against the fire panel before handover.
items.checklist:
Zone-wise announcement and background-music routing
Speaker spacing and amplifier taps calculated per space, not uniform
Emergency voice-evacuation (EVAC) integration with fire alarm panel
Speech-intelligibility checked per zone at commissioning
EVAC-to-fire-panel integration tested before handover

ConstructionInnerBanner.headline: Access control that ties to attendance and visitor logs
ConstructionInnerBanner.subtitle: Biometric and RFID proximity access, time-attendance integration and visitor management — for offices, IT parks and restricted areas.

items.heading: One system for entry, attendance and visitors
items.description:
Access control is more useful when it isn't a standalone door lock — we integrate biometric fingerprint or face access and RFID proximity cards with time-attendance so HR gets clean data automatically, and add visitor management and door interlocks for server rooms, record rooms and other restricted areas.

Every access point is tested for both the legitimate-entry and the deny scenario before handover, and door hardware is selected to match your fire-egress requirements — access control should never trap someone during an evacuation.
items.checklist:
Biometric fingerprint/face and RFID proximity access
Time-attendance integration for clean, automatic HR data
Visitor management for front-desk and restricted-area logging
Door interlocks for server rooms and record rooms
Fire-egress compliant door hardware — never a trap during evacuation
